question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Refined
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2) Crude** i.e. **Crude**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"refined"** means having or showing well-bred feeling, taste, manners, etc.; elegant. (सुसंस्कृत या परिष्कृत)

 
 
• **Example: **He has very refined tastes in music and art.
 
 
 
• **"Crude" **refers to something that is in a natural or raw state; not yet processed or refined; lacking in sophistication or good manners. (अशिष्ट या अपरिष्कृत)
 
 
• **Example: **His jokes were quite crude and not appropriate for formal settings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Crude**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Miserly **(कंजूस): Reluctant to spend money or use resources.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his wealth, he lived a miserly life.
 
 
 
• **Precise **(सटीक): Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions need to be more precise.
 
 
 
• **Genteel **(सभ्य): Polite, refined, or respectable, often in an affected or ostentatious way.
 
 
• **Example: **She maintained a genteel demeanor, even in difficult situations.
